psylliumDetailPolicy: Separate the bowel-function point from the ingredient-identity point. Explain raw psyllium gel formation, water retention and differences from inulin/bran without implying superiority across all fibers or transferring trial outcomes to this finished product.
cautionsPolicy: Only direct seller detail-page caution/label text, lightly paraphrased without additional diagnoses or ingredient-derived advice. Render only with verified seller provenance.
